oracle: a late save never leaves a draft on a superseded base
what: Remove the final writeDraft base check and ignore the old draft snapshot only after the publication changed the head, recreating an unconditional stale save.

target.case: A12.6 (racing a commit) a POST /draft on the base a concurrent commit is superseding is refused or lands first: it never leaves a draft on the superseded version, which GET /draft would serve to every editor (SPEC §2)

expect.message: no draft is left on a superseded base
